headline: Indian stock markets reverse early gains to decline amid global sell-off and profit taking

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Global sell-off and weak market cues weighed on benchmark indices.
Profit taking triggered a decline following a recent two-day rally.
Metal and banking shares dragged down Sensex and Nifty.
The Indian Rupee weakened by 23 paise to 92.85 against the U.S. dollar.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty opened higher on equity inflows but quickly reversed gains.
Sensex tumbled over 1,400 points from opening highs while Nifty fell below 25,700.
Tata Steel agreed to acquire a 26.6% stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 crore.
PL Capital retained a 'Reduce' rating on Tata Technologies citing limited upside.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty reversed early trade gains to fall sharply amid profit taking and global sell-offs. Metal and banking stocks led the downturn as Nifty slipped below the 25,700 mark. In major corporate developments, Tata Steel announced a 26.6% stake acquisition in APL Apollo.
